title: Homemade Pizza & Pizza Dough
instructions: Proof the yeast by placing the warm water in a large bowl, sprinkling the yeast over it, and letting it sit for 5 minutes.
Add flour, salt, sugar, and olive oil. Mix on low speed for a minute, then knead with dough hook for 7-10 minutes.
Spread olive oil inside a large bowl, place dough in it, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise for 1.5 hours.
Preheat pizza stone or baking sheet in oven at 475F for at least 30 minutes.
Shape dough, add toppings, and bake until crust is golden and cheese is bubbly.
substitutions: Using all-purpose flour instead of bread flour
Replacing mozzarella with cheddar or parmesan
Using chicken or bacon instead of Italian sausage
